How we handle website analytics, policy queries and support messages.

Microsoft Clarity: only on published university policy detail pages and after your explicit consent, Microsoft processes website interactions, device information and page URLs for heatmaps and masked session replays to improve usability. Search, internal pages and pages with query parameters are excluded. Advertising storage is denied; we do not send custom user identifiers. Ordinary playback is retained for 30 days; heatmaps, click data and labeled or favorited sessions for 9 months. You can withdraw consent below; disabling website analytics also disables Clarity. Microsoft applies its own privacy practices.
